Generated Narrative: CodeSystem bodystructure-origin

Last updated: 2021-01-05T10:01:24.148+11:00

This case-sensitive code system http://hl7.org/fhir/bodystructure-origin defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
autologous AutologousTissue, cells, or biological substances taken from the same individual.
non-autologous Non-autologousTissue, cells, or materials that are not taken from the same individual; they may come from a donor or be artificially created.
homologous HomologousTissue or cells taken from a donor of the same species.
allogeneic AllogeneicTissue or cells from another genetically different individual of the same species.
syngeneic SyngeneicTissue or cells taken from a genetically identical individual, such as an identical twin.
heterologous HeterologousTissue, cells, or materials from a genetically dissimilar source, commonly from a different species.
zooplastic ZooplasticTissue or graft material taken from a non-human animal species.
synthetic SyntheticMaterials created through chemical or other artificial processes rather than derived from living organisms.
mixed-source Mixed SourceA graft, transplant, or product that combines the patient's own biological materials with donor, animal, or synthetic sources.
